title: Issue map: search by issue number or keyword, every repository label in the Labels menu, and zoom and pan kept when filters change
summary: The issue map gained a search box (number or title words, Esc clears it first), the Labels menu lists every repository label via a new Rust command, and the map keeps zoom and pan across filter changes.

deferred.what: One Rust test in core/mcp_settings.rs is marked #[ignore] on main, so cargo test reports 1 ignored while CLAUDE.md states a skip-count baseline of 0; every reviewer has to stop and judge whether it is this PR's fault.
deferred.why: Pre-existing on main and outside this issue's seam.
